name.description:
Knowledge base name. Must be 2-64 characters of letters,
digits or underscores, and unique across all knowledge bases.

db_type.description:
Database type, either "normal" (plain JSON records) or
"vector" (vector knowledge base with embeddings). Defaults to "normal".

tools.name: get_knowledge_base
tools.description: Fetch the details of a knowledge base by its db_id.

tools.name: list_knowledge_bases
tools.description:
List all non-trashed knowledge bases.

Returns:
    A list of knowledge base summaries with id, name, type and counts.

db_id.description: The id of the knowledge base to rename.

new_name.description:
The new name. Must be 2-64 characters of letters, digits or
underscores, and unique across all knowledge bases.

tools.name: delete_knowledge_base
tools.description:
Soft-delete a knowledge base by moving it to the trash.

The knowledge base is not physically removed and can still be restored
through the backend trash endpoints.

db_id.description: The id of the knowledge base to delete.

tools.name: get_db_id_by_name
tools.description: Resolve the db_id of a knowledge base from its exact name.

db_name.description: The exact knowledge base name (case-insensitive match).

tools.name: upload_and_vectorize_document
tools.description:
Upload a local document into a vector knowledge base and vectorize it.

The file is read from disk and sent to the MooFile upload endpoint, then
a vectorization task is started for it. When `wait` is True the tool polls
the task until it finishes and reports the final state and chunk count.

local_path.description:
Absolute path of the document file on this machine.
Supported extensions (parseable by the backend worker): .txt, .md,
.markdown, .csv, .html, .htm, .json, .log.

db_id.description: The target knowledge base id; it must be a vector knowledge base.

chunk_size.description: Target chunk size in characters (100-2000, default 500).

overlap.description: Chunk overlap in characters (0 <= overlap < chunk_size, default 20).

model.description: Embedding model name; leave empty to use the knowledge base default.

wait.description: If True (default), block until the vectorization task completes.

timeout.description: Max seconds to wait for the task (default 600).

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List all documents of a knowledge base.

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Delete a document (and all of its vectorized chunks) from a knowledge base.

doc_id.description: The document id to delete (see list_documents).

tools.name: retrieve_knowledge
tools.description:
Semantic search over a vector knowledge base (RAG retrieval).

The query is embedded with the knowledge base's configured model and the
most similar chunks are returned. Omitting top_k / threshold makes the
backend fall back to the knowledge base's vectorConfig defaults.

top_k.description:
Max number of results (use 0 to fall back to the database
default, normally 10).

threshold.description:
Minimum similarity score to keep a result, 0-1
(use -1 to fall back to the database default, normally 0.3).
